documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Srivari Spices and Foods Limited reported its H1 FY26 financial performance, highlighting a 49.08% year-on-year growth in revenue to Rs. 77.77 crores and a 46.66% increase in PAT to Rs. 7.20 crores. Management discussed operational updates across product segments including Atta, Spices, recently launched Edible Oils, Soya Chunks, and upcoming devotional goods under the Neihaa Narayan brand. The company continues to focus on general trade expansion, regional marketing, and strengthening its product portfolio in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.

guidance.claim: Management stated that H2 will be better than H1 in terms of margins and oil revenue pick up.
guidance.quote: So, that will be picked up very well. So, H2 will be better than H1.

guidance.claim: Management noted they are optimistic about revenues and expect to maintain better percentage growth than past years.
guidance.quote: What we did in the past 3 years that will be better than, in percentage wise you will find everything better, EBITDA as well as PAT and revenue, all will be better than in percentage.

guidance.claim: Management stated that FY27 will be the best in their past complete history regarding growth.
guidance.quote: As I said, new products are launched, so might be 100% will achieve. Exactly, I can't comment on that. But it will be better than, FY '27 will be the best in our past complete history.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the demand environment continues to be encouraging.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand environment continues to be encouraging and we are confident of sustaining the growth momentum in the second half.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted very good response from the market for groundnut oil.
demand_outlook.quote: But we are having very good response from the market.

demand_outlook.claim: The Indian soy protein market is projected to grow at a CAGR of ~6% from 2024 to 2029.
demand_outlook.quote: The Indian soy protein market is projected to grow at a CAGR of ~6% from 2024 –2029, driven by rising health awareness and higher protein consumption.

demand_outlook.claim: Over 70% of Indians do not consume the recommended daily protein intake.
demand_outlook.quote: Over 70% of Indians do not consume the recommended daily protein intake (Source: Indian Market Research Bureau).

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that 70% of the spices and atta markets are currently unorganized, presenting an opportunity for growth as consumers shift towards packaged and quality products.
demand_outlook.quote: As I said, one important thing is in the spices, still 70% is an unorganized trade. So, after the post COVID, now people are moving to the packaging and quality products. So, 70% will now come down by 2030, we are expecting 70% will be the organized trade.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated they plan to introduce a new business vertical focused on puja articles and devotional goods.
capex_expansion.quote: Looking ahead, we are planning to introduce a new business vertical focused on manufacturing, trading and distribution of puja articles, devotional goods, festival related items and allied products.

capex_expansion.claim: Management plans to install a plant for Soya Chunks later after 2 quarters.
capex_expansion.quote: Install the capacity later, after 2 quarters.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated they are planning for an expansion plan within 2 years after the next financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: Within 2 years, we have to plan. It will take some time. After the next financial year, we have to go for the expansion plan.

capex_expansion.claim: The company launched a new oil plant and officially introduced its products in Mumbai on 28 July 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: Launched a new oil plant and officially introduced its products in Mumbai, Maharashtra on 28 July 2025 .

capex_expansion.claim: The company is planning its growth chapter with the launch of the Neihaa Narayan puja devotional articles goods vertical.
capex_expansion.quote:
Srivari Spices & Foods is planning its next growth chapter with the launch of a new business vertical
This vertical will focus on manufacturing,

trading, and dealing
Adoption of

capex_expansion.claim: The company launched its new edible oil manufacturing plant and commercial production began on May 10, 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: and we launched our edible oil on 10th May 2025 and it started its commercial production on 10th May 2025.

capex_expansion.claim: The installed capacities are 3,600 tons per annum for spices and masalas, 14,400 tons per annum for atta, and 7,200 tons per annum for oil.
capex_expansion.quote: For spices and masalas, we have an installed capacity of 3,600 tons per annum with the current utilization at about 2,637 tons. When it comes to atta, 14,400 tons per annum installed capacity and we have utilized 12,650 tons. Regarding oil, we have installed capacity of 7,200 tons per annum but this plant is yet to be commercialized.

margins_costs.claim: H1 FY26 EBITDA margin was 17.05% and PAT margin was 9.14%.
margins_costs.quote: Our profitability remained healthy with EBITDA margin of 17.05% and PAT margin of 9.14%.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that monthly advertising spend on media channels is Rs. 5-6 lakhs.
margins_costs.quote: So, altogether monthly we are spending Rs. 5-Rs. 6 lakhs on the media channels, new media channels.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for H1 FY26 stood at 17.05%.
Profit margin for H1 FY26 was reported at 9.14%.
Management noted that PAT decreased due to the new plant commencement and claiming six months of depreciation.
margins_costs.quote: Still the one thing I want to focus and just give the clarity on that. Our PAT has been decreased. See PAT has been decreased due to the new plant commencement and we have claimed the depreciation of the 6 months because of that PAT has been decreased, but our overall numbers are positive.

orders_capacity.claim: Installed capacity and utilization were reported as 3,600 tons and 2,637 tons for Spices, 14,400 tons and 12,650 tons for Atta, and 7,200 tons and 720 tons for Oil.
orders_capacity.quote: For Spices, we have an installed capacity of 3,600 tons and we have utilized 2,637 tons. And when it comes to Atta, installed capacity is 14,400 tons and we have utilized 12,650 tons. When it comes to Oil, we have installed capacity of 7,200 tons and we have utilized 720 tons.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated they are serving around 3,000 stores in Jumbotail.
orders_capacity.quote: So, we are doing, we are serving around 3000 stores in Jumbotail itself as of now.

capital_allocation.claim: Management noted short-term borrowings increased due to an overdraft on the last day of September.
capital_allocation.quote: Actually, mainly there was one OD came on the last day of September. So, that contributed so much towards short-term borrowings.

capital_allocation.claim: Rights shares were issued on 10th October 2024 to enhance the capital structure.
capital_allocation.quote: Rights Shares issued on 10th Oct, 2024 to enhance capital structure.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated they did not reach last year's committed growth percentages due to challenges of a new setup and a delay in the rights issue.
risks_headwinds.quote: Yes, as we have in the earlier this investor's meet we have committed some growth percentage and we didn't reach out in the last year that we do because of the challenges of this new setup. It's a huge setup and second thing was the delay in the rights.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to launch the new Pooja and devotional products vertical in January.
management_commitments.quote: In Jan, roughly in the Jan, we are going to launch.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated they will plan for export market expansion in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Definitely. But in FY '27. Next year, we will plan for the expansion. Next year, we are into the planning for that.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets reaching up to 30% utilization in the Oil segment in H2.
management_commitments.quote: I think next financial year, H2 will be utilized almost 30% easily. We can reach up to 30%. Now, we can utilize up to 30% in this H2.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
